title: ROI Calculator
description: Calculate the return on investment (ROI) as a percentage.

faqs.question: What is the ROI formula?
faqs.answer: ROI = ((Final Value − Initial Investment) ÷ Initial Investment) × 100.

faqs.question: Does ROI account for time period?
faqs.answer: No — this is a simple total-return ROI. Annualized ROI requires factoring in the investment duration.
